Definition: properly, to strike in, i.e. fix; specifically, to plant (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to plant, fasten, fix, establish; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to plant; 1a2) to plant, establish (fig.); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be planted; 1b2) to be established (fig.)
